photos.desc: Thalassocnus , Cervical vertebrae of T. natans (MPC 704-A). Atlas in anterior (A), right lateral (B), and posterior (C), views. Third cervical vertebra in anterior (D), left lateral (E), and posterior

Thalassocnus , Skull of T. natans (MPC 704-A) in ventral view (A,B). Abbreviations: apfs, anterior palatine foramina; bf, buccinator fossa; bo, basioccipital; eam, external auditory meatus; ef, forame

Thalassocnus , Skull of T. natans (MPC 704-A) in dorsal view (A,B). Abbreviations: bs, basisphenoid; eo, exoccipital; fdv, foramen for diploic vein; fo, foramen ovale; fr; frontal; icf, internal carot
Fossil - Took the picture at Museum of Natural History, Karlsruhe

Thalassocnus , Left pelvis of T. natans (MPC 704-A) in dorsal (A) and lateral (B) views. Abbreviations: ac, acetabulum; an, acetabular notch; ic, ischiatic cornu; ipe, iliopectineal eminence; iw, ilia
Thalassocnus , Astragalus and calcaneus of T. natans (MPC 704-A). Right astragalus in dorsal (A,B), plantar (C,D), ﬁbular (E,F), and distal (G,H) views. Righ calcaneum in lateral (I,J), dorsal (K,L),

Thalassocnus , Left tibia of T. natans (MPC 704-A) in anterior (A,B), lateral (C,D), posterior (E,F), and medial (G,H) views. Abbreviations: af, astragalus facet; dff, distal facet for the ﬁbula; gfdl
Thalassocnus natans skeleton, Muséum national d'histoire naturelle, Paris.
